The '''''Heyblibber Duck'''''<ref name="Jar Jar 1">[[Jar Jar 1|''Jar Jar'' 1]]</ref> was an [[H-type Nubian yacht]] flown by [[Ric Olié]] on a mission to transport [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] to [[Urubai]] to meet with [[Ambassador]] [[Upsina]].<ref name="Jar Jar 1" /> It was later used by [[Jedi Master]] [[Kelleran Beq]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge]] to transport the [[youngling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] off [[Coruscant]].<ref name="The Foundling" />
